headline: Appointments and re-appointments to the cultural council, fire department, conservation commission, and veterans service commissioner.
summary: Eight people are named for new appointments or re-appointments. Six of them are new appointees, including three permanent full-time firefighters.
items: New appointment: Stephanie Lee and Kathleen G. Goss to the Fitchburg Cultural Council
New appointment: Cole Johnson, Chase Bourgault, and Andrew St. Denis as permanent full-time firefighters for the City of Fitchburg
New appointment: Jeanne M. Hudson to the Fitchburg Conservation Commission
Re-appointment: Michele Marino as Veterans Service Commissioner
Re-appointment: Sean-Michael Tantinarawat to the Fitchburg Conservation Commission
location: Legislative Building, 700 Main Street, Fitchburg, MA 01420
